Observability and heal helpers for closed kernel.cas_object_* mutation kinds.

Compose materializes pipeline_definition rows from kind×intent composition.

See docs/architecture/KERNEL_MUTATION_PIPELINE.md.

  Coverage + composition registry size
  zqk system kernel-integrity report
  Compile definitions without writing CAS
  zqk system kernel-integrity compose --dry-run
  Materialize pipeline_definition rows
  zqk system kernel-integrity compose
  Preview dangling-ref unlinks
  zqk system kernel-integrity heal-dangling
  Preview missing work-envelope clocks
  zqk system kernel-integrity backfill-work-envelope

Usage:
  zqk system kernel-integrity [command]

Available Commands:
  backfill-work-envelope Stamp missing completed_at from historical updated_at on effort-aware work-done objects
  compose                Compile kind×intent mutation pipelines and materialize pipeline_definition rows
  heal-dangling          Unlink dangling references on critical process kinds
  report                 Report pipeline kind coverage, lifecycle YAML presence, and composition registry

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running

Use "zqk system kernel-integrity [command] --help" for more information about a command.
